summary: Executed targeted backend+frontend verification for SustainRepo contact email template and Supplier Ranking overview enhancements. Email template content checks passed without sending mail; ranking UI/API behaviors passed. One auth/CORS security regression remains.

critical.issue: CORS response returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin='*' instead of explicit trusted origin while credentials are enabled.

action_items: Fix auth preflight CORS behavior so trusted origin is echoed (not '*') when allow_credentials=true.
Validate ingress/proxy layer is not overwriting backend CORS headers for /api/auth/login.
critical_code_review_comments: Supplier ranking risk matrix grouping/mapping is implemented correctly in UI: critical(high emission/low ESG), priority(high/high), developing(low/low), strategic(low/high).
Ranking API currently returns supported document/training statuses for tested data; keep status normalization guarded to prevent unsupported DB values from leaking.
Auth CORS behavior at runtime does not match server.py explicit-origin configuration, indicating deployment-layer header override or middleware mismatch.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin login + Supplier Assessment > Ranking verified on public URL. Risk matrix rendered with 4 points, right-side legend text matched required quadrant mapping, hover tooltip showed supplier name + ESG score + attributed emissions, and document/training matrices both rendered with assigned rows. Contact email template validated via _confirmation_email unit test only (no outbound email submission).
rca of the issue: Repro: OPTIONS /api/auth/login with trusted Origin header returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin='*'. Expected explicit trusted origin from CORS_ORIGINS when credentials enabled. server.py enforces explicit origins, so wildcard likely introduced by upstream edge/proxy configuration (or alternate runtime path) before response reaches client.
